label: H.R. 2493
title: Improving Care in Rural America Reauthorization Act of 2025

items.snippet: This bill reauthorizes through FY2030 grant programs administered by the Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA) that provide funding to health care service providers and related entities in rural areas.
